display_long_description:
In CALL OF SY, you awaken as a corporate soldier in a world ravaged by climate collapse. Your body follows corporate commands; your mind echoes neural-link orders. But everything shifts when the creature you were meant to destroy sets you free. She gives you a key and a mission: protect a sacred amulet. To do so, you'll need to break with the logic of destruction and open yourself to other cosmologies.

Alongside your Companion, you begin to reclaim your identity, drawing adinkras on your hands and following paths guided by Katú Mirim, where you must choose: dystopia or forest? Deep within the forest, Davi Kopenawa shares Yanomami wisdom and hands you the sacred object, stirring memories of a sky about to fall. When the corporation attacks, your combat gestures—taught by the collective Legítima Defesa—defend the object until it reveals its true form: a living seed.

You are transported to a quilombo. Beneath a sacred samaúma tree, Denilson Baniwa, Tikuna Maguta, Jota Mombaça, and other guardians of ancestral memory lead a collective ritual. In the trance that follows, visions and dances reveal that resistance lives in body, word, and dream.

CALL OF SY is an immersive experience about decolonization, regeneration, and alliances between worlds. Here, the future is ancestral, knowledge is collective, and each gesture holds the power to grow tomorrow.
